webOnly.title: Only on the website
webOnly.description: This feature is only available on the TrackGeek website for now.

tour.menuDescription: Replay the guided tour of the app.

welcome.title: Welcome to TrackGeek!
welcome.description: Let's take a quick tour of the feed, your progress, search and how to add things to it. You can skip at any time.

tabs.title: The feed
tabs.description: Following shows what the people you follow are doing, Global shows everyone, and Trending shows what is getting attention.

compose.title: Share something
compose.description: Write a post, attach a title or a screenshot, and share it with the community.

header.title: Your profile
header.description: Your avatar, level and followers live here. Tap Edit to change how your profile looks.

tabs.title: Your progress
tabs.description: Each tab shows a different side of your account. Once you track something, a Progress tab appears with everything you are watching, reading or playing, organized by status.

bar.title: Search
bar.description: Type a name to find movies, TV shows, anime, manga, games, books, cast and other users.

kind.title: Choose what to look for
kind.description: Switch between types of media, cast and users. Open any title to continue the tour and see how to add it to your progress.

status.title: Add it to your progress
status.description: Pick a status to add this title to your progress. After that you can update episodes, chapters or hours, rate it and write a review.
